Installation Instructions:  1: Flip the Tow/Run Switch to the TOW position (this should be done whenever you are servicing the cart)  2: Disconnect main positive and negative battery cables to your cart 3: Remove the ADC speed sensor from the end of your cart motor  4: Now you can gain access to the magnet. Excel vehicles have serial number prefixes of PH, PJ, PU or PD This magnet is a "half-pulse" magnet. Once installed on your motor it will still communicate to the speed sensor exactly as the other magnet did, but only half as often. This magnet won't give you a boost of power or torque it merely raises the electronic rev limiter so high that the vehicle will never reach it. In turn, you will be able to run the full potential of your vehicle..The regenerative motor braking becomes completely disabled when this magnet is installed and will allow you to "free-wheel" down hills.
